mentions.name: Sandlot
mentions.description: Sandlot is a Rust wrapper around SDL3 that enforces lifetimes and provides an idiomatic Rust interface, reducing opportunities for footguns compared to using SDL3 directly.
mentions.problem: SDL3's raw interface leaves room for lifetime errors and other footguns when used from Rust.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently iterating on Sandlot, an SDL3 wrapper in Rust that enforces lifetimes and generally offers an idiomatic Rust interface with less opportunities to shoot yourself in the foot.
mentions.author: lyorig
